about: Per-pin absolute-maximum registry for gates/pin_absmax.py. `nets`: a declared voltage range per net, relative to a named reference net, each with a citation or a derivation checked against the frozen netlist. `parts`: per IC MPN, the datasheet absolute maximum (and recommended range) of each pin function as V(pin) - V(reference pin), each with the PDF page and a verbatim row quote (checked offline by --verify-datasheets). Anything not declared is UNDECLARED.
page_basis: page numbers are PDF page indices (1-based) of the file named in datasheet.file; they equal the printed page for the TI sheets
datasheet_dir_note: datasheets live outside the repo (untrusted downloads): worktrees/runs-native21/pin-absmax-dl/pdf; manifest MANIFEST.sha there

_default.quote: unlisted resistor families are bounded at 5 %

undeclared_notes.leg_a.driver-dt: 2EDR8259X STP/DTC: a resistor-programmed, device-regulated pin; the datasheet gives no voltage for the node (Table 9 only bounds it by VDDI + 0.3 V)
undeclared_notes.ct_sense_mon: BAS116H clamp diodes D4 / D5 to V3V3 / SELV_GND behind R42 (1 k): needs a diode Vf row and the TLV3201 note-2 10 mA clause (inputs may swing >0.5 V beyond the rails if current-limited)
undeclared_notes.ct_s2: current-transformer secondary reference node (R40 / R41 bias plus the CT signal): needs the CT burden model, not a rail figure
undeclared_notes.led1: mains-driven LED branch of U36 (R67 / R68 / R69 / R70 from L_FILT / N_FILT): a series-resistor-limited LED, VR 6 V applies to the reverse junction; needs the LED Vf row
undeclared_notes.hb_hold: U40 input on the D19 / C164-C166 hold network (RC with a Schottky): no analysed bound yet
